hero.title: Your training data belongs to you.
hero.lead: OpenStride brings your Garmin and Strava activities together in one place, and keeps them on your device. Not on our servers.
hero.note: No account to create, no subscription, no tracker.

connect.title: 1. Plug in your watch
connect.text: Garmin in a few clicks, or your Strava account archive. Your activities arrive whole: GPS track, heart rate, cadence, elevation.

analyze.title: 2. Analyse without a black box
analyze.text: Personal records, best times, segments, progress over the year. Every calculation is open: if a number surprises you, you can go read where it came from.

own.title: 3. Stay in charge
own.text: Your activities live in your browser. Cloud backup is there if you want it — you switch it on, and you pick the provider.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: No account, no tracker. Your data goes nowhere until you ask it to.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.text: The code is public, and so are the algorithms. Including the ones that compute your performance.

free.title: Free
free.text: No subscription, no premium tier, nothing behind a paywall.

extensible.title: Extensible
extensible.text: OpenStride is built from plugins. Missing your watch, or the chart you like? It can be added.

sources.title: Your sources
sources.lead: What works today. The list grows as plugins land.

strava.name: Strava
strava.how: Import your archive — FIT, GPX and TCX included

closing.title: Take your data back.
closing.text: A few minutes to import years of training. And nothing to uninstall if you change your mind: it was yours all along.
